description: This file is a JavaScript source script that sets up, tests, and validates an OpenClaw plugin build and runtime environment. It handles importing modules, configuring plugin directories, ensuring dependencies exist, registering commands, and performing assertions to verify plugin loading and command matching.

methods.name: installProcessWarningFilter
